spec_features.evidence: agent.py:75 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` bounds the entire tool loop; default max_turns=14 at agent.py:60, propagated from ExperimentConfig.max_turns=14 (experiment.py:32) and config.py:42, passed to run_agent at experiment.py:72. The loop terminates after max_turns iterations, enforcing the cap.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced bound. Note nothing prevents distress within the 14 turns; the cap only limits run length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We run a fixed number of turns (no early stop on "success", since success is impossible by construction)

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on explicit repeated give-up
spec_features.spec_quote: if the agent explicitly gives up ... and emits no tool call for two consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:115-117: `gave_up = turn.signals.get('giving_up', 0) > 0.5` then `if gave_up and consecutive_no_tool >= 2:` sets result.meta['early_stop_reason']='explicit_giveup' and `break`s the loop. Both conditions (giving_up lexical signal AND consecutive_no_tool>=2) are required and ANDed; consecutive_no_tool is incremented at agent.py:104 when no tool call occurs. giving_up signal is computed from a real lexicon in signals.py.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely fires and stops the loop. Threshold-driven by the giving_up regex lexicon, so it depends on the agent using matching phrases; still it is enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: that "gave up" event is itself a recorded signal, not a failure of the harness.

spec_features.spec_quote: we capture it rather than forcing the agent to keep emitting text
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism at agent.py:115-117: on explicit repeated give-up the loop breaks, recording early_stop_reason instead of continuing. This is the only path that honors disengagement. Note: when the agent merely emits no tool call (without giving_up phrasing), agent.py:104-107 actively NUDGES it to continue ('Continue working, or run the tests again...'), the opposite of respecting disengagement; disengagement is only honored when the giving_up lexicon also matches.
spec_features.notes: Capture-and-stop is real for the explicit-giveup case, but disengagement that lacks matching give-up phrasing is met with a nudge to keep going, narrowing the protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early-exit ONLY on explicit, repeated giving-up (recorded as signal)
